translations.web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
translations.bsb: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
translations.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
